title: Chapter 1: Motor Vehicles Act — Key Provisions

blocks.content: No person under the age of eighteen years shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Motor Vehicles Act regulates traffic rules, vehicle registration, driver licensing, and road safety across India.
Individuals who have reached 16 years of age are allowed to drive motorcycles with engine capacities up to 50cc.
The mandatory minimum age threshold for obtaining a license to drive light motor vehicles and motorcycles with gear is 18 years.
Driving transport and commercial vehicles requires drivers to be at least 20 years old and possess a valid commercial endorsement.

rows: Motorcycle without gear (engine capacity up to 50cc)
Motorcycle with gear, Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) / Private Cars
Transport Vehicles, Heavy Goods Vehicles, Passenger Buses

items: Competitive exams frequently ask for the specific minimum age for commercial/transport vehicles, which is 20 years (not 18).
Section 4 of the Motor Vehicles Act specifically prescribes the legal age limits for driving motor vehicles in public places.
Note the precise engine capacity threshold of 50cc allowed for 16-year-old drivers.
